correctness.rationale: Let a=9^{2/3}; H²=(a u²+v²)/4. Homogeneity reduces sharp H≤N to a polynomial whose nonconstant coefficients are positive for t≥0 and equality only at axes. Ratio R(t)=[8+(1+t)³]^{2/3}/(a+t²) rises then falls, since φ(t)=t(1+8/(1+t)²) is strictly increasing; its unique τ gives Rmax≈1.299582043601. Arbitrary tilted quadratic forms cannot beat it: using x=(1,0),y=(0,τ), N(x+y)=N(x−y) and the Euclidean parallelogram equality yield distortion²≥Rmax; H attains. Independent symbolic polynomial check and high-precision numerical stationarity τ≈2.766739880... verify constants; finite grid not the universal proof.
